name: Exp_2pbIdealXOSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the 2pbIdealXOSMA custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed oscillator with adjustable smoothing. It generates buy signals when the oscillator histogram turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward, using the slope direction of consecutive histogram bars to determine entries.
summary_zh: 该EA基于2pbIdealXOSMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标是带有可调平滑参数的三重平滑振荡器。当振荡器柱状图转向上方时产生买入信号，转向下方时产生卖出信号，通过连续柱状图条的方向变化来判断入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于2pbIdealXOSMA指标，这是一个三重理想移动平均振荡器，通过三组平滑周期（X、Y、Z）分别进行粗平滑和调整平滑，再对直方图进行额外平滑处理。入场条件：当macd[1]<macd[2]（直方图从下降转为上升）且macd[0]>macd[1]（确认上升动能）时开多仓；当macd[1]>macd[2]且macd[0]<macd[1]时开空仓。出场条件：使用固定点数的止损和止盈，同时允许通过信号反向平仓——当出现卖出信号时平多头，出现买入信号时平空头。仓位管理方面，MM参数为负值时表示固定手数，为正值时表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制，默认值-0.1表示使用0.1手固定手数交易。策略依赖新K线检测（IsNewBar）来避免重复信号，仅在每根新K线时重新计算交易信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the 2pbIdealXOSMA indicator, a triple ideal moving average oscillator that applies three pairs of rough and adjusting smoothing periods (X, Y, Z), followed by an additional smoothing pass on the histogram. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when macd[1]<macd[2] (histogram transitions from declining to rising) and macd[0]>macd[1] (confirming upward momentum); a sell signal triggers when macd[1]>macd[2] and macd[0]<macd[1]. Exit conditions use fixed stop loss and take profit in points, while also permitting signal-based exits—long positions close on sell signals and short positions close on buy signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes while positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management defaults to MM=-0.1, meaning a fixed 0.1 lot per trade. The strategy relies on new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent duplicate signals, recalculating trading signals only on each new bar formation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，负值为固定手数，正值为存款比例
parameters.description_en: Money management: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 三重平滑振荡器设计有效减少了市场噪音，提高了信号质量
具有独立的买卖开关控制，灵活性高，可单独启用或禁用开仓和平仓
新K线检测机制防止同一根K线内重复触发信号
支持10种平滑算法选择，适应不同市场环境
止损止盈参数齐全，基本风险控制到位
pros_en: Triple smoothing oscillator design effectively reduces market noise and improves signal quality
Independent buy/sell permission switches provide high flexibility for enabling or disabling entries and exits separately
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signal triggers within the same bar
Supports 10 smoothing algorithm options, adaptable to different market conditions
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 所有平滑周期默认值均为10，缺乏差异化，可能导致信号迟钝或过度平滑
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生虚假信号
缺少仓位检查逻辑，可能重复开仓导致风险叠加
依赖自定义指标文件，部署复杂且无法独立验证指标逻辑
止损1000点和止盈2000点设置偏大，可能不适合所有品种
cons_en: All smoothing periods default to 10 without differentiation, potentially causing sluggish or over-smoothed signals
No spread filter, which may generate false signals in high-spread environments
Lacks position check logic, risking duplicate positions and accumulated exposure
Depends on a custom indicator file, complicating deployment and preventing independent indicator logic verification
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are relatively large and may not suit all instruments
improvements: 添加点差过滤机制，在点差过大时禁止开仓以避免滑点损失
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
为三组平滑周期设置不同的默认值，使指标对不同频率的信号有差异化响应
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to prevent opening positions when the spread is too wide, avoiding slippage losses
Add position check logic to avoid duplicate same-direction entries that could lead to excessive risk exposure
Set different default values for the three smoothing period groups so the indicator responds differently to various signal frequencies

risk_points: 缺少持仓方向检查，可能重复开仓导致风险叠加
自定义指标依赖性，若指标文件缺失或异常将导致交易信号错误
无点差过滤，高点差环境下入场成本不可控
risk_points_en: No position direction check, potentially allowing duplicate entries that accumulate risk exposure
Custom indicator dependency—if the indicator file is missing or malfunctioning, trading signals may be erroneous
No spread filter, making entry costs uncontrollable in high-spread environments
